data.body: [non-codebase] evidence for the Gerrit-votes AC: bridge change 2392 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2392) received LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 and was Submitted by the human operator (not self-submitted). It MERGED to origin/main as commit d0bcd620 (the raised REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB=563200 bridge + self-documenting comment naming restore ticket fluorspar-comparable-zeren).
